english.title: Fail give PC / authorised person acting under the Act assistance / information - London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to give to

(A)_[a police constable]_
(B)_[an authorised officer]_

acting in pursuance of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998 such assistance or information as you were reasonably required by that person to give for the purpose of performing

(C)_[his]_
(D)_[her]_

functions under this Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27(2)(b) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.
